# orchestration_cluster_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group inside a Camunda cluster by name. See the Camunda documentation on [groups](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/group/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestration_cluster_group" "example" {
  name = "Example Group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the group to look up. Must match exactly one group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the group.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the group.
